title: Soleil at Seagrove | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every detail of the home is thoughtfully curated, from the spa-inspired primary suite and private Gulf-view office to the cozy bunk nook and two laundry stations with built-in coffee bars. Beyond the main residence, a private carriage house and expansive courtyard offer serene escapes and alfresco living, complete with an outdoor fireplace, grilling station, and three-car air-conditioned garage. At the heart of the estate, a spectacular indoor-outdoor pavilion connects seamlessly to a second pool and sunning terrace, creating the ultimate setting for gathering under the Florida sun. This is more than a beachfront home; it’s a legacy of unforgettable experiences, beautifully designed to be shared. A true coastal showpiece, this extraordinary estate blends architectural grandeur with effortless luxury, designed for celebrating life’s most meaningful moments. Set just steps from Seagrove Beach, the home offers a breathtaking backdrop of sugar-white sand and emerald water, ideal for weddings, reunions, or refined retreats. A grand spiral staircase and glass-wrapped elevator welcome guests with dramatic flair, while multiple guest suites and living areas ensure privacy and comfort at every turn. The second floor dazzles with Gulf-front dining, a culinary-grade kitchen, and seamless access to the infinity-edge pool deck, all crafted to elevate entertaining to an art form.
